svg.title: SHSI (Optics Express 2025, MATLAB): Tunable sparse Hadamard patterns preserve orthogonality and improve noise resilience, supported by a sparsity-dependent noise model.
svg.desc: Portrait-derived decorative motif: computed Walsh-Hadamard samples 49 through 72 of the author's public portrait. Each interval is independently linearly scaled; these are not project measurements or performance. Research context: Measurement design · theory and optical experiments.
